description: Aeronautical Climatological Summary - Luxembourg/Findel Airport (ELLX) is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MeteoLux. The aeronautical climatological summary is based on recommendations from the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and is available to all stakeholders of Luxembourg/Findel airport (ELLX), such as aircraft operators and administrations as well as other aeronautical users. The summary of climatological information is intended to assist stakeholders in strategic and operational planning. Coverage: MeteoLux. The publisher named on the listing is MeteoLux. Its keywords include environment, meteorology, climat, weather. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
